issues.failure_explanation: The surrogate defined in (eq:surrogate_MU) is tangent at H_n^j (gradient ∇f(h_n), center h_n), so its gradient is ∇f(h_n) + (D_n^j+ρI)(h − h_n) and its unconstrained minimizer is h_n + (D_n^j+ρI)^{-1}(W^TX^j − W^TW h_n). The proof instead differentiates the H̃_n-centered quadratic (displayed gradient with −ρh̃_n^j), whose argmin is (D+ρ)^{-1}(W^TX^j + ρh̃_n), i.e., the MUR update. The two coincide only when H_n ≥ δ entrywise; when thresholding is active (h_{n,a} < δ) the defined surrogate's minimizer differs from the MUR update, so point [NMF_claim_2] (exact minimization, hence Δ_n ≡ 0 verifying A4) is false as stated. The same construction is reused for MUR in the NCPD setting.
